text:
A nichrome wire, P, has a length of 1.0m and a diameter of 1.0mm.
A second nichrome wire, Q, has a length of 2.0m and a diameter of 2.0mm.
Which statement correctly compares the resistance of Q with that of P?
A
The resistance of Q is one-quarter the resistance of P.
B
The resistance of Q is one-half the resistance of P.
C
The resistance of Q is the same as the resistance of P.
D
The resistance of Q is four times the resistance of P.

options.label: A
options.text: The resistance of Q is one-quarter the resistance of P.

options.label: B
options.text: The resistance of Q is one-half the resistance of P.

options.label: C
options.text: The resistance of Q is the same as the resistance of P.

options.label: D
options.text: The resistance of Q is four times the resistance of P.
